sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Find the orange object and click on it
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

orange_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'O']
print(f"Orange objects: {len(orange_nodes)}")
for n in orange_nodes:
    boundary = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
    center_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    print(f"  Node {n['id']}: pixels={n['pixels']}, boundary={boundary}, center=({center_row}, {center_col})")

# Click on the orange object
if orange_nodes:
    target = orange_nodes[0]
    boundary = target['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
    click_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    click_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    print(f"\nClicking at ({click_row}, {click_col}) on orange node {target['id']}")
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': click_row, 'col': click_col}])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
